description: A room's threads and board cards, built like MatchaRoomStore.buildSnapshot. events are the room's Matcha events, newest first: card revisions, metadata patches, bootstrap replies and thread replies (which stand in for the replies read per thread). threads is the SDK thread list with each root's body and sender, the latest reply's sender and the latest activity time. legacyArchive holds com.matchahoneylatte.thread_archive state by thread root id. directMembers is empty outside direct chats. Threads are ordered by latest activity, newest first; cards keep standalone cards first, then one card per thread.

cases.name: every thread projects to exactly one card named after the thread
the newest revision of a card wins
an invalid newest revision is dropped and the older valid one wins
a card unlinked from its thread gives way to the thread's card, so ids stay unique
an explicit thread restore wins over an archived card
without an explicit thread archive the card decides
the legacy archive state brings in a thread and archives its card
a legacy false does not bring in a thread
a thread missing from the thread list is named after its card
threads are ordered by latest activity
a revision of another board is ignored
a task hidden from the room is not shown to someone it does not involve
a task hidden from the room is shown to a replier
a task hidden from the room is shown to the thread's latest sender
redacted replies and senders that are not user ids are not participants
a standalone card involves the authors of its revisions without a thread
in a direct chat its members are involved in every task
the hidden bootstrap reply marks its thread and its sender takes part
deadlines and reminder requests travel with the thread's card
a user id is read by code point: a combining mark may follow its @
